requirements.title: Procedure definitions classify procedures as functions or subroutines and define their references
requirements.definition: A procedure definition specifies a function or subroutine; function references appear as expression primaries or defined operations, and subroutine references are CALL statements, defined assignments, defined I/O processing, or finalization.
requirements.oracle:
Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish distinguished non-default state first, then observe portable single-image properties such as exact integer values, exact character results, successful execution, or source-use attribution. Unnumbered program restrictions do not create a required processor diagnostic; negative examples for those facets are retained only as source-control material.

S15.2.1-001 procedures_15_1_15_3 runtime fixtures: Generated run/effect/f2023 fixtures function_subroutine_references exercise the selected facets with nondefault integer sentinels and exact integer, logical, character-length, shape, pointer-association, procedure-reference, or control-flow observations. Every case prints one exact completion line only after all guards have reached the rule-owned effect. Generated feature mutations redirect the procedure designator, remove the reference form, alter the selected target, or change the declared characteristic being observed so the parent oracle is load-bearing.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Diagnostics are not claimed unless a numbered constraint or syntax rule requires them; this scope contains no numbered R/C unit.

S15.2.1-001 procedures_15_1_15_3 boundaries: Coverage is limited to ordinary single-image Fortran sources accepted by both validation compilers. The fixtures do not assert addresses, layout, processor-dependent diagnostics, IOMSG text, IEEE or coarray behavior, interoperability with a separate C companion, or unnumbered-prose rejection. Facets left pending remain source-use-only, coarray-only, governed by later owner rules, or lacked a load-bearing portable mutation in this packet.
requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies: clauses 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, and 13 for source form, declarations, expressions, execution constructs, data transfer, and formatting foundations already present in this suite. Unregistered dependencies retained for future fixtures: later clause 15 procedure reference, argument association, interface block, generic resolution, pure/simple/elemental, procedure pointer, and finalization rules; clauses 16, 17, and 18 for intrinsic and intrinsic-module procedures; clause 14 for modules and submodules; clause 3 terminology and clause 19 scoping/lifetime details.

requirements.title: Elemental procedures are procedures that can be referenced elementally
requirements.definition: A procedure is classified as elemental by its ability to be referenced elementally.
